In mathematics, Fatou's lemma establishes an inequality relating the Lebesgue
integral of the limit inferior of a sequence of functions to the limit inferior
of integrals of these functions.

:::{.theorem data-title="Fatou's Lemma"}

If $X_{n}\geq 0$ then
$$
\liminf_{n \to \infty}\mathbb{E}[X_{n}] \geq  \mathbb{E}\left[\liminf_{n \to \infty}X_{n}\right].
$$

:::
